title: Manuel Perez's playing and the Roof Garden band, 1925-27
summary: Williams describes Perez as a legitimate brass-band trumpeter and lists the Roof Garden band he worked in from 1925 to 1927.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: How was Manuel Perez? Some people talk like he was the greatest of ever, and others say that he wasn't such a hot trumpet player, just a note reader, and that he really couldn't think anything. How did you like him? What did he sound like? He was a legitimate trumpet player.

Much more legitimate. Yeah, yeah. He wasn't a hot trumpet player, not a jazz trumpet player like of today. That's right, strictly music. That's right, a legitimate trumpet player. Did he have a big tone or? Nice tone, kind of nice tone. But it wasn't a fine tone, you know. It was more of a brass band tone, you see. Yeah. Kind of rough, you know. Loud, high notes. Notes didn't come too high, you see. Fine musician. Yeah, that's what I've heard. Yeah, I worked with him on the Roof Garden, Maurice Durand and I, and Buddy Johnson, he was a Yanks brother. We worked on the Roof Garden two years from 25 to 27. We had Emmanuel Perez, Buddy Johnson, myself, Eddie Sherry, you heard of him. And Lil' Caffrey, Darius Boyd on the guitar. You heard of Caffrey, Darius Boyd, and him. And, uh...
Who was the alto player? Was it before Tad's or after him?
We had Sherry and Tad. You had them both, huh? We had Sherry and Tad. And, uh, piano player, what's her name? Still on Josephine Street. She played with Celestine Lakeley. Uh...
Uh... Ken Ed? Ken Ed? Mercedee's... That's it. Mercedee's. She worked up there with us two years.

Mercedee's going on the three years. Then after, yeah, that's right. Then after she worked with us, uh... I see old Blanchett. You heard of him. Oh, yes. And he worked with us. What's he doing? I see. He's a school teacher. And we had a teacher at 35. Teacher at 35.
Yeah, very awesome. 35, Rampart and Girard. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
